welcome.title: Halve the food your family throws away.
welcome.lead: Frigo is a free fridge coach: it remembers what you bought, warns you before food goes bad and shows how much you saved.
welcome.step1: Add what's in your fridge — 3 taps, or let Frigo guess the date.
welcome.step2: Check the colours: red is expired, yellow means use it soon.
welcome.step3: Tap “Used it” or “Tossed” and watch your savings grow.
welcome.free: Free forever. Supports UN Goal 12.3 — halve food waste by 2030.
